summary: Novartis AG filed a Form 6-K on July 21, 2026, containing its Q2 2026 financial report (Exhibit 99.1) and interim financial report (Exhibit 99.2). The filing is a routine quarterly earnings announcement, not a special situation. It reports net sales growth of +1% cc and core operating income flat, with pipeline updates on products like Kisqali and Kesimpta, and reaffirmed full-year 2026 guidance. This is a standard financial disclosure by a foreign private issuer, not a transaction event.
